- **Possible exploring** · A stopping of therapy comes twenty-four weeks past a second dose of two long-acting antibodies, and twenty-four weeks past a clearing of those antibodies from a body is a separate thing a timing was not set by. — at "twenty-eight selves who had all rebounded on placebo, given two long-acting antibodies and interrupted twenty-four weeks after antibodies cleared, more than half staying past twenty weeks and two past a year"

- A taste paired one time with an immunosuppressing drug brings a weakened antibody response when the taste comes again with the drug absent, and a taste paired with a drug that leaves immunity whole brings the taste aversion with the antibody response whole. *(possible exploring)*

- One hormone pulsed brings on ovulation and the same hormone continuous suppresses sex-hormone release; a parathyroid hormone injected once daily builds new bone and the same hormone chronically high depletes bone; a pattern of delivery parts the two effects and an amount holds them alike. *(possible exploring)*

- A drug-associated place conditions a body against a drug, so a repeated dose brings tolerance and a last dose in a new place kills at about twice the rate of the usual place, at about 32% in the same setting, 64% in a new one and 96% in drug-naive animals. *(possible exploring)*

- Receptors and single ion channels open and close all-or-none with an agonist absent, mutant receptors fixed at the active side bring disease, and some antagonists lower a receptor's activity below its agonist-absent level. *(possible exploring)*

- One ligand is a neutral antagonist at a receptor in one state and an inverse agonist at the same receptor after morphine exposure, so a receptor's state sets the sign of the ligand's effect rather than the ligand alone. *(possible exploring)*

- Ibuprofen's one hand undergoes a one-way inversion to the other in the body; ethambutol's two hands and its even form are equally potent at the optic nerve while one hand is 500-fold and 12-fold more potent against tuberculosis; carvone's two hands smell of spearmint and of caraway. *(possible exploring)*

- Crystalline uric acid, cholesterol crystals in arteries and silica in the lung bring inflammation at the place they lodge; fibres long enough to be incompletely engulfed by a clearing cell drive a sustained release of inflammatory mediators toward fibrotic and carcinogenic outcomes; wear particles from an artificial joint bring resorption of living bone around an implant, which can loosen it. *(possible exploring)*
- Mitochondria taken from a child's own muscle and injected into heart muscle after a loss and return of blood flow go with improving ventricular function. *(possible exploring)*

- Medicine delivers living things and sequences: blood and organ transplants, marrow and stem-cell transplants, faecal community transplants, engineered immune cells, live vaccines, phages, maggots, leeches, and grafts of skin and cornea; a working gene within a viral capsid as one infusion to infants with spinal muscular atrophy; donor pancreatic islets into the liver in type 1 diabetes; and a messenger sequence within a lipid nanoparticle about a hundred nanometres across that cells read to make an antigen while the body's own genome stays whole and the body dissolves the sequence within a few days. *(possible exploring)*

- Lithium calms mania; and lithium reverses the hyperexcitability of dentate-gyrus-like neurons grown from people with bipolar disorder only in neurons from people who themselves respond to lithium. *(possible exploring)*

- Monoaminergic antidepressants hold a delayed onset of at least a week; blocking hippocampal neurogenesis blocks their behavioural effect; new adult hippocampal neurons take about three to six weeks to mature; and chronic fluoxetine reinstates ocular-dominance plasticity in the visual cortex of adult animals and recovers visual function in adult amblyopic animals. *(possible exploring)*

- About seventy per cent of treatment-resistant patients improve within a day of a single dose of ketamine; in a stressed animal a single low dose raised synapse-associated proteins in the prefrontal cortex within two hours and raised budding synaptic spines within twenty-four hours, with the effect lasting at least a week. *(possible exploring)*

- **Possible exploring** · Anaesthetic potency measured in tadpoles rises nearly linearly with the oil-to-water partition coefficient across alcohols, aldehydes, ketones, ethers and esters, and ceases to rise past a chain length of about thirteen carbons; xenon, a noble gas forming no ordinary bonds, anaesthetizes animals and people; and a pure soluble protein, firefly luciferase, is inhibited by half at anaesthetic concentrations essentially identical to those that anaesthetize animals across a hundred-thousand-fold range of potencies, the anaesthetics competing with its substrate. — at "anaesthesia's molecular event"

- Paracetamol is deacetylated in the brain and spinal cord and joined to the body's own arachidonic acid to make AM404, a potent TRPV1 agonist that also blocks the sodium channels NaV1.7 and NaV1.8 at nanomolar amounts, and this joining and the pain relief are absent in animals lacking the joining enzyme or TRPV1. *(possible exploring)*

- A desert iguana raises its body temperature about two degrees after bacterial infection and survives more often when it can reach that temperature, an antipyretic that prevents the rise raising deaths; and most human rhinovirus replicates better at the cool nasal temperature of thirty-three to thirty-five degrees than at thirty-seven, in part through a weaker antiviral interferon response of the infected cells at the cool temperature. *(possible exploring)*

- GLP-1, a hormone of thirty amino acids made in the gut's L-cells and released at meals, raises glucose-dependent insulin, slows gut motility and curbs appetite, and is broken down within about two minutes; and a GLP-1 analogue with two amino-acid changes and a fatty-acid moiety binds albumin and resists degradation, lasting about a week in the plasma for once-weekly dosing. *(possible exploring)*

- A provocative probe sounds a latent departure ahead: a cosyntropin probe leaves cortisol flat in primary adrenal failure, a sodium-current-blocking drug reveals a Type 1 Brugada pattern in a heart that shows an ordinary trace at rest, a dobutamine stress echo finds wall segments failing to move at an ischaemic heart, a dexamethasone probe leaves an autonomously acting adrenal axis unsuppressed, a naloxone challenge brings on withdrawal at a carried dependence, edrophonium briefly restores strength in myasthenia gravis, and a glucose-shaped tracer gathers at the cells changing fastest. *(possible exploring)*

- Amyloid-β protects against fungal and bacterial infection, its soluble oligomers binding microbial cell-wall carbohydrates and its fibrils agglutinating and entrapping the microbes, and a brain infection seeds and accelerates amyloid-β deposition that sits with the bacteria; driving fast-spiking interneurons or a light flickering at forty hertz lowers amyloid-β in some brain regions with microglia changing form, and a later work finds no reliable lowering of amyloid load across its models. *(possible exploring)*

- Mimosa leaves, pea tendrils, Venus flytraps and sundew traps lose their autonomous and touch-induced movements under anaesthetics and recover within minutes, the flytrap's loss coming from blocked action potentials; induction of anaesthesia and emergence from it follow different concentrations, the half-effect of induction above two and a half times that of emergence for one agent; and reversal of anaesthesia by high pressure appears in some species and conditions alone. *(possible exploring)*

- Certain metabolic stimuli, glucose and pyruvate among them, enable aminoglycosides to kill dormant persisters of Escherichia coli and of Staphylococcus aureus, an effect specific to aminoglycosides that proceeds without growth resumption, holds with and without air, treats biofilms of both bacteria, and improves treatment of a chronic urinary tract infection in a mouse model. *(possible exploring)*

- **Possible exploring** · Of eighty people with irritable bowel syndrome, seventy per cent women and a mean age of forty-seven, thirty-seven given pills openly described to them as inert improve more over three weeks than forty-three given the same provider contact alone, global improvement 5.2 against 4.0 at day 11 and 5.0 against 3.9 at day 21, with lower symptom severity and more adequate relief at both days and a trend in quality of life at day 21, p = .08. — at "*Placebo* — an inert substance holding no active magnitude, producing a measurable effect."

- Of two hundred and thirty-eight children in hospital with infectious mononucleosis, one hundred and seventy-three given antibiotics, a rash during the illness comes at 57 (32.9%) of those given antibiotics against 15 (23.1%) of those given an absence of them, a difference given as P = .156, and with amoxicillin the rash is at 29.5%, 95% confidence interval 18.52 to 42.57, far below the 90% reported for ampicillin in the past. *(possible exploring)*

- Thirty-six healthy adults, eighteen in each arm, ate a diet high in fermented foods or a diet high in fibre for ten weeks; the fermented-food diet raised gut microbial diversity, more with larger intake, and lowered nineteen of ninety-three measured inflammatory serum proteins, interleukin-6 among them; the high-fibre diet left diversity and those nineteen proteins alike across the cohort over the same span. *(possible exploring)*

- Across forty-eight randomised trials with 6,674 participants with mood disorders, lithium against an inert pill goes with fewer suicides, odds ratio 0.13 (0.03 to 0.66), and fewer deaths from any cause, 0.38 (0.15 to 0.95), with no clear benefit for deliberate self-harm, 0.60 (0.27 to 1.32); a later review of twelve trials with 2,578 participants gives an odds ratio for suicide of 0.41 (0.03 to 2.49), inconclusive; across fifteen ecological studies covering 1,286 regions in seven countries, places with more naturally occurring lithium in drinking water hold lower suicide mortality, pooled standardised coefficient -0.27 (-0.47 to -0.08), -0.13 for women and -0.26 for men, at trace amounts far below medicine's maintenance level of 0.6 to 1.0 mmol/L, toxic above 1.5. *(possible exploring)*

- Two lithium isotopes, apart only at the nucleus, part at a living animal: rats fed lithium-6, lithium-7 or naturally occurring lithium at 2.0 mEq/kg each day and made hyperactive with ketamine at 25 mg/kg lowered the hyperactivity alike on the first trial, and by the fourth trial lithium-6 lowered it more and for longer than lithium-7 and than naturally occurring lithium. *(possible exploring)*

- **Possible exploring** · In the liver about 90% of a paracetamol dose passes to conjugation and about 10% is oxidized to the reactive NAPQI, which glutathione conjugates to compounds passed in urine; in overdose above about 150 mg/kg glutathione is depleted, a fall of about 70% proposed as the limit past which the binding comes, NAPQI binds the liver cells' own proteins and the cells die, and N-acetylcysteine within the first 8 to 10 hours restores glutathione and lowers mortality from 5% to 0.7%. — at "a same molecule is medicine or poison by a coefficient of its coupling"

- **Possible exploring** · Placebo knee surgery of skin incisions and a simulated procedure improved pain and function as much as real arthroscopic débridement or lavage across one hundred and eighty people over twenty-four months, mean knee-specific pain at one year on a nought-to-hundred scale 48.9 with placebo, 54.8 with lavage and 51.7 with débridement; and of fifty-three trials of surgery against a placebo procedure the placebo arm improved in 39 (74%), the placebo's effect did not differ from surgery's in 27 (51%), and surgery was superior in 26 (49%), generally by a small margin. — at "an inert substance holding no active magnitude, producing a measurable effect"

- **Possible exploring** · Against a placebo procedure, coronary stenting for single-vessel disease gave a gain in exercise time 16.6 seconds greater than placebo in one trial of two hundred patients on about three anti-anginal drugs, 95% confidence interval -8.9 to 42.0, p = 0.200, no clear gain; and in another trial of three hundred and one patients off all antianginal medication, one hundred and fifty-one to stenting and one hundred and fifty to placebo, the mean angina symptom score at twelve weeks on a nought-to-seventy-nine scale was 2.9 with stenting against 5.6 with placebo, odds ratio 2.21 (1.41 to 3.47, P<0.001), about three times as many free of angina. — at "an inert substance holding no active magnitude, producing a measurable effect"

- **Possible exploring** · Among sixty Amish and Hutterite children of similar genetic ancestry, the Amish on traditional farms and the Hutterites on industrialized ones, asthma is four times as low and allergic sensitization six times as low in the Amish, median house-dust endotoxin 6.8 times as high and innate immune cells differing, and farm-house dust extracts given into mice's noses suppress allergic airway disease through innate immune pathways; asthma comes in about one in twenty Amish children and one in five Hutterite children, and hay fever is less common in children with more older siblings. — at "early-life exposure tracking later allergic and metabolic disease"

- **Possible exploring** · Introducing peanut early in infancy to six hundred and forty infants with eczema or egg allergy lowered peanut allergy at sixty months, among the five hundred and thirty with a negative skin-prick test at entry, from 13.7% with avoidance to 1.9% with consumption, and among the ninety-eight with a wheal of one to four millimetres from 35.3% to 10.6%; and infant gut bacteria differ between populations, early dominance by Bacteroides going with more autoimmunity and allergy and one bacterium's lipopolysaccharide bringing less innate immune activation. — at "early-life exposure tracking later allergic and metabolic disease"

- In one thousand six hundred and forty-three people with acute low back pain, regular paracetamol at 3,990 mg a day, as-needed up to 4,000 mg a day and placebo gave median recovery at 17, 17 and 16 days, hazard ratio for as-needed paracetamol against placebo 1.05 (0.92 to 1.19); a single dose of 1,000 mg lowered empathy for others' physical and social pain across eighty and one hundred and fourteen people, pooled falls in perceived pain 0.23, personal distress 0.47 and empathic concern 0.45, and over three weeks lowered self-reported social pain and the brain responses to social rejection, physical and social pain coming with one same coupling. *(possible exploring)*

- Of drug programmes entering phase I, 9.6% reached approval and 5.1% in oncology, the lowest of fourteen disease areas; and of one thousand and twenty-six experimental acute-stroke treatments the one hundred and fourteen carried into people were no more effective in experiments than the nine hundred and twelve tested in animals alone, the acute-stroke treatments that work reopening the blocked vessel. *(possible exploring)*

- Gene expression of human trauma, burn and endotoxin conditions correlate with one another, trauma against burns R-squared 0.91, and poorly with the matching mouse models, R-squared at most 0.09 with 47 to 63% of genes changing in the same direction, a re-evaluation of genes changed in both giving Spearman 0.43 to 0.68 with 77 to 93% in the same direction; of seventy-five first-in-class medicines fifty were small molecules, twenty-eight from phenotypic screening and seventeen from target-based approaches; and new drugs approved per inflation-adjusted research dollar have halved about every nine years since 1950, a roughly eightyfold fall. *(possible exploring)*

- One gram of intravenous paracetamol each six hours for fever in seven hundred critically ill patients with infection against an inert pill gave a median of 23 and 22 ICU-free days to day 28, P = 0.07, and deaths by day 90 in 55 of 345 (15.9%) and 57 of 344 (16.6%); and a model of published data estimates that suppressing fever raises influenza cases and deaths, by 5% (0.2 to 12.1%) for seasonal and 1% (0.0 to 2.7%) for pandemic influenza, through more virus shed and more movement while contagious. *(possible exploring)*

- Thalidomide's two hands interconvert, a racemization half-life about twelve hours in buffer and about one hour in serum; one single hand is teratogenic and the other is-not despite ready interconversion in the body; stirring thalidomide of 20% enantiomeric excess enriches it to as much as 98%, and the even mixture dissolves in water at about 62.5 µg/mL against about 345 to 349 µg/mL for each single hand. *(possible exploring)*

- In one thousand seven hundred and ninety-five people with early Alzheimer's disease, eight hundred and ninety-eight on the drug and eight hundred and ninety-seven on an inert pill, a dementia rating worsened over eighteen months by 1.21 points with the drug and 1.66 with the inert pill, a difference of -0.45 (-0.67 to -0.23), 27% of the placebo change, brain amyloid falling 59.1 centiloids more in a substudy of six hundred and ninety-eight, with infusion reactions in 26.4% and amyloid-related imaging abnormalities with oedema or effusions in 12.6% of those on the drug; amyloid pathology rises from 10% of people at age fifty to 44% at ninety; and many older people carry abundant plaques and tangles with intact cognition, loss of synapses tracking cognitive decline more closely than plaques do. *(possible exploring)*

- Eligibility for a shingles vaccine set by date of birth, uptake rising from 0.01% to 47.2% across the cut-off, went among two hundred and eighty-two thousand five hundred and forty-one older adults with a fall in new dementia diagnoses over seven years of 3.5 percentage points (0.6 to 7.1), a relative fall of 20.0% (6.5 to 33.4), stronger among women, and a follow-up with the same design finds fewer diagnoses of mild cognitive impairment and fewer deaths from dementia. *(possible exploring)*

- In one thousand nine hundred and sixty-one adults, semaglutide at 2.4 mg once weekly for sixty-eight weeks beside lifestyle change changed mean body weight by -14.9% against -2.4% on an inert pill, and in a smaller trial of forty-eight adults nine weeks of it, 0.25 mg weekly for four weeks, 0.5 mg for four and 1.0 mg for one, lowered the alcohol drunk and the cigarettes smoked; a year after the drug stopped about two thirds of the weight loss had returned, a net loss of 5.6% from 17.3%, and the cardiometabolic gains reverted toward their starting values. *(possible exploring)*
